entries.title: Job 41:1
segments: ¶"Can you draw out Leviathan with a hook, Or [snare] his tongue with a line [which] you lower?

entries.title: Job 41:2
segments: Can you put a reed through his nose, Or pierce his jaw with a hook?

entries.title: Job 41:3
segments: Will he make many supplications to you? Will he speak softly to you?

entries.title: Job 41:4
segments: Will he make a covenant with you? Will you take him as a servant forever?

entries.title: Job 41:5
segments: Will you play with him as [with] a bird, Or will you leash him for your maidens?

entries.title: Job 41:6
segments: Will [your] companions make a banquet of him? Will they apportion him among the merchants?

entries.title: Job 41:7
segments: Can you fill his skin with harpoons, Or his head with fishing spears?

entries.title: Job 41:8
segments: Lay your hand on him; Remember the battle-Never do it again!

entries.title: Job 41:9
segments: Indeed, [any] hope of [overcoming] him is false; Shall [one not] be overwhelmed at the sight of him?

entries.title: Job 41:10
segments: No one [is so] fierce that he would dare stir him up. Who then is able to stand against Me?

entries.title: Job 41:11
segments: ¶Who has preceded Me, that I should pay [him]? Everything under heaven is Mine.

entries.title: Job 41:12
segments: "I will not conceal his limbs, His mighty power, or his graceful proportions.

entries.title: Job 41:13
segments: Who can remove his outer coat? Who can approach [him] with a double bridle?

entries.title: Job 41:14
segments: Who can open the doors of his face, [With] his terrible teeth all around?

entries.title: Job 41:15
segments: [His] rows of scales are [his] pride, Shut up tightly [as with] a seal;

entries.title: Job 41:16
segments: One is so near another That no air can come between them;

entries.title: Job 41:17
segments: They are joined one to another, They stick together and cannot be parted.

entries.title: Job 41:18
segments: His sneezings flash forth light, And his eyes [are] like the eyelids of the morning.

entries.title: Job 41:19
segments: Out of his mouth go burning lights; Sparks of fire shoot out.

entries.title: Job 41:20
segments: Smoke goes out of his nostrils, As [from] a boiling pot and burning rushes.

entries.title: Job 41:21
segments: His breath kindles coals, And a flame goes out of his mouth.

entries.title: Job 41:22
segments: Strength dwells in his neck, And sorrow dances before him.

entries.title: Job 41:23
segments: The folds of his flesh are joined together; They are firm on him and cannot be moved.

entries.title: Job 41:24
segments: His heart is as hard as stone, Even as hard as the lower [millstone].

entries.title: Job 41:25
segments: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid; Because of his crashings they are beside themselves.

entries.title: Job 41:26
segments: [Though] the sword reaches him, it cannot avail; Nor does spear, dart, or javelin.

entries.title: Job 41:27
segments: He regards iron as straw, [And] bronze as rotten wood.

entries.title: Job 41:28
segments: The arrow cannot make him flee; Slingstones become like stubble to him.

entries.title: Job 41:29
segments: Darts are regarded as straw; He laughs at the threat of javelins.

entries.title: Job 41:30
segments: His undersides [are] like sharp potsherds; He spreads pointed [marks] in the mire.

entries.title: Job 41:31
segments: He makes the deep boil like a pot; He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

entries.title: Job 41:32
segments: He leaves a shining wake behind him; [One] would think the deep had white hair.

entries.title: Job 41:33
segments: On earth there is nothing like him, Which is made without fear.

entries.title: Job 41:34
segments: He beholds every high [thing]; He [is] king over all the children of pride."
